bio: MAP Maison is a sophisticated cocktail bar with a premium range of spirits and a meticulous blend of art, music, design, food and drinks. Their unique Tapas Style Afternoon Tea is a contemporary twist to this classic British tradition.  This modern venue has a classy 1920's style interior providing guests with elegant surroundings in which they can indulge in a variety of sweet and savoury treats.  At MAP Maison, cocktails are their pursuit, with a great passion for making cocktails, guests can experience not only the taste, but the skill, care and love that goes into making them.  Accompanying the creative tea menu is a tapas styled selection of savouries and sweets. Following a variation of the traditional Afternoon Tea theme, savoury choices include; mini sourdough baguettes with Mediterranean toppings, mini Iberico burger and tempting vegetarian bites.  Afternoon Tea is served 5pm -7pm Monday - Wednesday, 3pm - 6pm on Thursdays, 1pm - 5pm on Fridays, 12pm - 5pm on Saturdays, and 12pm - 7pm on Sunday
